name: Precious Achiuwa

name: Devin Vassell

name: Dylan Harper

name: Keldon Johnson

name: Victor Wembanyama

name: Immanuel Quickley

name: Scottie Barnes
blurb: Mixed: 2 over, 1 in line and 1 under. Minutes swing (26-37) around a usual 30; the 26 came in a blowout. Scoring above his usual rate in 2 of 4.

name: Ace Bailey
blurb: Over ETR in three of four, by 10-18 points, and rebounds are the reason: 10-12 in each of his last two. Minutes have grown to 29-34 against a usual 25. A growing role.

name: Darryn Peterson

name: Keyonte George

name: Lauri Markkanen

name: Alex Sarr

name: Anthony Davis

name: Kyshawn George

name: Trae Young
